title: Dauch Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Dauch Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026, disclosing the termination of Tolga Oal as President – Axle Systems, effective April 16, 2026. The termination was approved by the Board of Directors on April 13, 2026. Mr. Oal will receive severance benefits pursuant to the company's Executive Officer Severance Plan.

Company is headquartered at One Dauch Drive, Detroit, Michigan
Common stock trades under symbol DCH on the New York Stock Exchange
